title: The Way to King Street
question: Why did the man need a phrasebook?

meanings.usage: lose one's way 表示迷路，lose的过去式为lost
表示事情发生得很意外，没有预兆
旅行者用的外语常用语手册
衣服上的口袋，或口袋里的东西
作名词指德语，作形容词指德国的
形容人微笑或说话时的态度
修饰动词，表示动作的速度
ask someone the way 向某人问路
tell someone something 告诉某人某事
人体部位，也可作动词表示递交
find something 找到某物，过去式为found

phrases.usage: 迷路，指找不到要去的地方

examples.en: She lost her way in London.
The tourists lost their way in the forest.
examples.zh: 游客们在森林里迷路了。

examples.en: I can ask him the way.
May I ask you the way to the station?
examples.zh: 我可以向你问一下去车站的路吗？

phrases.phrase: Can you tell me the way to...?
phrases.usage: 你能告诉我去...的路吗？用于礼貌地问路

examples.en: Can you tell me the way to King Street, please?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我去国王街的路吗？

examples.en: Can you tell me the way to the museum?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我去博物馆的路吗？

phrases.usage: 打扰一下，用于引起注意或打扰别人前

examples.en: Excuse me, can you help me?
examples.zh: 打扰一下，你能帮帮我吗？

examples.en: Excuse me, is this your pen?
examples.zh: 打扰一下，这是你的钢笔吗？

examples.en: He put his hand into his pocket.
examples.zh: 他把他的手伸进口袋里。

examples.en: She put her hand into the bag.
He took out a phrasebook.
She took out her keys.

phrases.usage: 对不起/很抱歉，用于道歉或表达遗憾

examples.en: I am sorry, I do not speak English.
I am sorry, I am late.
I do not speak English.
Do you speak French?
She said to herself.
He thought to himself.
He read the phrase slowly.
Please read the text slowly.

sentences.en: Last week Mrs. Mills went to London.
sentences.zh: 上周，米尔斯夫人去了伦敦。

sentences.en: She does not know London very well, and she lost her way.
sentences.zh: 她对伦敦不熟悉，迷路了。

sentences.en: Suddenly, she saw a man near a bus stop.
sentences.zh: 突然，她看到一个男人在公交车站附近。

sentences.en: 'I can ask him the way,' she said to herself.
sentences.zh: “我可以问他路，”她自言自语道。

sentences.en: 'Can you tell me the way to King Street, please?'
sentences.zh: “请问，你能告诉我国王街怎么走吗？”
那个男人友好地笑了笑。

sentences.en: Then he put his hand into his pocket, and took out a phrasebook.
sentences.zh: 然后他把手伸进口袋，掏出了一本常用语手册。

sentences.en: He opened the book and found a phrase.
sentences.zh: 他翻开书，找到了一句话。

options: 一般过去时与一般现在时的对比

exercises.explain: 一般过去时与一般现在时的对比：现在时: 主语 + 动词原形/三单形式 过去时: 主语 + 动词过去式：在叙述故事时，背景描述用现在时，具体事件用过去时

grammar.title: 一般过去时 (Past Simple Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的动作或存在的状态，常与表示过去的时间状语连用，如last week, yesterday等。
grammar.structure: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他 主语 + did not (didn't) + 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.usage: 用于叙述过去发生的事情，描述一系列按时间顺序发生的动作

examples.en: Last week Mrs. Mills went to London.
examples.zh: 上周 Mills 夫人去了伦敦。

examples.en: She lost her way.
He did not understand English.
He took out a phrasebook.

grammar.title: 一般过去时的否定句和疑问句
grammar.definition: 否定句在动词前加did not (didn't)，动词恢复原形。疑问句将did提到句首。
grammar.structure: 否定句: 主语 + did not + 动词原形 + 其他 一般疑问句: Did + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他？
grammar.usage: 用于对过去发生的动作进行否定或提问

examples.en: He did not understand English.
Did she lose her way?
Did he speak German?

grammar.title: 一般过去时与一般现在时的对比
grammar.definition: 一般现在时描述习惯性或经常发生的动作；一般过去时描述过去发生的具体事件。
grammar.structure: 现在时: 主语 + 动词原形/三单形式 过去时: 主语 + 动词过去式
grammar.usage: 在叙述故事时，背景描述用现在时，具体事件用过去时

examples.en: She does not know London very well.
examples.zh: 她对伦敦不太熟悉。（现在时，描述一般状态）

examples.en: She lost her way.
examples.zh: 她迷路了。（过去时，描述过去事件）

original.en: Can you tell me the way to King Street, please?
original.zh: 你能告诉我去国王街的路吗？

examples.zh: 你能告诉我去车站的路吗？

examples.en: Can you tell me the way to the airport?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我去机场的路吗？

examples.en: Can you tell me the way to the museum?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我去博物馆的路吗？

patterns.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他 (叙述过去事件)

original.en: She saw a man near a bus stop.
original.zh: 她在公共汽车站附近看到一个男人。

examples.en: She lost her way yesterday.
He took out his phrasebook.
She went to London last week.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + did not + 动词原形 (过去时否定)

examples.en: I did not see him yesterday.
She did not know the way.
They did not speak Chinese.

patterns.pattern: I am sorry, I do not speak + 语言

original.en: I am sorry, I do not speak English.

examples.en: I am sorry, I do not speak French.
I am sorry, I do not speak Japanese.
I am sorry, I do not speak German.
